focus: Data visualization, statistics, statistical analysis, and reproducible scientific computing
title: From Business Questions to Useful Data Evidence
utility_title: CSV Statistics and Bootstrap Interval Utility
utility_use_case: A lab analyst receives a CSV of sensor readings and needs a quick, reproducible summary before preparing a report. The analyst confirms that each row represents one independent reading, checks how blanks and malformed values are counted, then runs `bash csv-statistics.sh --file measurements.csv --column value --seed 42`. The JSON provides the usable sample size, basic descriptive statistics, and a percentile bootstrap interval for the mean. The seed, input file, and command can be recorded alongside the report for repeatability. The interval describes resampling variability under the observed values; it does not validate sensor calibration, establish representativeness, or support a causal claim.
